summary: Iteration 4 (dedupe + preview upscaling) validated end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed. (1) Rome-Live timeseries now dedupes by acquisition date — pair_details shows unique dates (T33TTG_20240603 → T33TTG_20240608 → T33TTG_20240618 → T32TQM_20240628 → T33TTG_20240708); total_pairs=4 (post-cap), s2_pairs=11 (12 unique dates after dedupe vs 24 raw obs = correct); tracks=8 (was 0 in iter 3). (2) Observation preview PNG opened via PIL: dims >=256×256 confirmed. (3) Change crop PNGs (before/after/diff) opened via PIL: all >=256×256 confirmed on both CRL small-polygon events (previously 11×10) and new Rome-Live timeseries events. (4) Single-pair /api/v1/change-detection contract unchanged (200/400/422 as expected; existing 0.75 persistence events intact). Frontend: Rome-Live → set-before[0] + set-after[3] → imagery-layer-toggle visible → layer-after loads crisp Sentinel-2 RGB overlay + 8 change polygon outlines drawn over Rome; dashboard shows CHANGES=8, LARGEST=Infrastructure 3.67 ha. Persistence variance note: all 8 tracks currently have persistence=0.25 because polygons only appeared in 1 of 4 pairs (pair 3: T32TQM_20240628→T33TTG_20240708 produced 8 polygons; pairs 0/1/2 produced 0). This is legitimate real-data behaviour — persistence is computed correctly, NOT hardcoded 0.75. The request expected 'some 0.25, some 0.5, some 1.0' which is data-dependent and cannot be forced.

minor.issue: Rome-Live tracks now >0 (=8) after dedupe, but all 8 have persistence=0.25 because 3 of 4 pairs still produced 0 polygons (thresholds too high or actual scene change too subtle across consecutive 5-10 day intervals). Not a code bug — persistence math is correct (obs_in_pairs/total_pairs). If the product needs multi-pair recurrence to demonstrate 0.5/1.0 values, consider (a) lowering optical threshold slightly for demonstration AOIs, (b) increasing MAX_PAIRS beyond 4 (currently caps at 4), or (c) selecting an AOI with more construction/change activity.

action_items: (Optional) To exercise persistence>0.25 the timeseries needs actual multi-pair recurring change. Consider lowering pipelines.detect_optical_changes threshold or picking a busier AOI. Current behaviour is correct.
(Optional) Cap MAX_PAIRS=4 in orchestrator.run_timeseries_detection means s2_pairs=11 reported in diag but only 4 processed — consider raising cap or documenting the truncation in output.
critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator.run_timeseries_detection: diag['s2_pairs']=11 is computed BEFORE the MAX_PAIRS cap is applied, but total_pairs (used for persistence denominator) is computed AFTER — mildly misleading; consider aligning by reporting both processed_pairs and available_pairs.

previews._resize_min uses Image.BICUBIC which is fine, but for very small source (<16px) BICUBIC on 4x-8x upscale produces blurry output; consider LANCZOS for higher quality thumbnails or an initial NEAREST 2x expand.
polygon_bbox_padded still only reads coordinates[0] — MultiPolygon geometries will IndexError (pre-existing issue from iter 3, not addressed in iter 4).
server change_crop endpoint has no cache header; every UI mount fires 3× fresh crop renders. Consider Cache-Control: max-age or ETag on stable event/tif combos.
orchestrator._dedupe: helper argument 'key' is unused; can be removed.
